flow.profile.initial.label: Initial
flow.profile.initial.description: The magnifier button: finds the devices present on the network.
flow.profile.associative.label: Associative
flow.profile.associative.description: The scan of the selected devices before adding them to the dashboard.
flow.profile.deep.label: Deep
flow.profile.deep.description: The rescan of devices already in the dashboard, also during nightly maintenance.
flow.step.arp.label: ARP discovery
flow.step.arp.description: Finds the hosts on the network via ARP. Required in the initial search.
flow.step.mdns.label: mDNS names
flow.step.mdns.description: Reads the names devices announce via Bonjour/Avahi.
flow.step.reverse_names.label: Reverse name lookup
flow.step.reverse_names.description: Asks devices that still have no name directly.
flow.step.ssdp.label: SSDP/UPnP
flow.step.ssdp.description: Detects name, manufacturer and model of devices that answer UPnP.
flow.step.netbios_snmp.label: NetBIOS and SNMP
flow.step.netbios_snmp.description: Queries NetBIOS and SNMP, useful for PCs, printers and NAS.
flow.step.ports_fast.label: Ports (fast)
flow.step.ports_fast.description: Looks for open ports with a quick scan.
flow.step.ports_all.label: Ports (all)
flow.step.ports_all.description: Checks every port, with a longer time limit.
flow.step.service_os.label: Services
flow.step.service_os.description: Identifies services and versions on the open ports. Slower.
flow.step.http_title.label: Web title and port check
flow.step.http_title.description: Confirms which ports really serve a web page and reads its title. Needs a port scan.
flow.step.adapter_probe.label: Adapter detection
flow.step.adapter_probe.description: Recognizes supported devices (e.g. Shelly). Needs a port scan.
flow.error.not_a_list: The function list for "{profile}" is not valid.
flow.error.not_applicable: The function "{step}" does not apply to the "{profile}" search.
flow.error.required: The function "{step}" is required in the "{profile}" search.
flow.error.empty: The "{profile}" search needs at least one active function.
flow.step.onvif.label: ONVIF / WS-Discovery
flow.step.onvif.description: Cameras, NVRs, printers and Windows PCs declare name and model (UDP 3702).
flow.step.rtsp.label: RTSP
flow.step.rtsp.description: Reads the Server header of video streams (TCP 554), without credentials.
flow.step.tls_ssh.label: TLS certificate and SSH key
flow.step.tls_ssh.description: Reads the certificate of HTTPS services (name, issuer) and the SSH fingerprint: recognises the device even if its IP changes.
flow.step.local_api.label: Manufacturer local interfaces
flow.step.local_api.description: Shelly, Tasmota, Sonos, Roku and Chromecast declare model and firmware through their documented interface (read only).
flow.step.igmp.label: IGMP (multicast)
flow.step.igmp.description: Who receives multicast streams (TV, Chromecast, IPTV). Off by default: on networks with provider IPTV the query may interfere.
flow.risk.easy.label: Non-intrusive
flow.risk.easy.description: Standard, light network requests: they do not disturb devices.
flow.risk.invasive.label: Intrusive
flow.risk.invasive.description: Queries the device directly (ports, certificates, APIs): it may appear in its logs or in security alerts.
flow.risk.risky.label: Risky
flow.risk.risky.description: Aggressive or very long probes: they may slow down or hang fragile devices.
flow.step.ha_registry.label: Home Assistant data
flow.step.ha_registry.description: Reads name, manufacturer, model and area from Home Assistant for the devices it knows (read-only, matched by MAC).
